CJ McCollum.text: A Top 160 player now and for the rest of the season. He ranked 128th last season on 29.8 minutes and now plays about 27, with a starting job that looks stable. Free throws at 82.4% sit above his career 75.9%, which leaves little room to improve. Turnovers of 2.0 a game are the main drag.

CJ McCollum.text: McCollum's job is safe: he has started every game, and the 32 minutes on Nov 2 came with Johnson and Landale out. Expect a Top 150 player for the rest of the season (Lock).
